interpretation: Observational analytics describe associations only; they do not establish causal effects.

distribution_shift.description: deterministic replay-only metric transform; historical partition remains unchanged

duplicate_replay.description: exact duplicate replay events; semantic event set must be unchanged

late_event_omission.description: remove the 96 designated delayed events to measure sensitivity to missing late arrivals

out_of_order.description: reverse and seeded-shuffle ingestion; event-time holdout must be unchanged

sparse.description: retain one replay event per campaign variant across replay holdout
